entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an official Hermes Agent provider through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine to deliver sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for high-volume token processing. It unifies memory, RAG, and user profiles into a single API that supports multi-modal extraction from sources like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An open-source context database that employs the viking:// protocol and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to optimize token expenditure. It demonstrates significant task-completion gains and provides observable retrieval trajectories to assist in debugging agent memory workflows.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain constructs a self-wiring knowledge graph using typed edges to synthesize answers with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for local deployment using PGLite to maintain a structured and searchable memory architecture.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This system focuses on long-term memory through specialized retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agents to learn over time. It offers Python and Node.js SDKs alongside Docker-based deployment options for integrating persistent memory into agentic stacks.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Serving as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers, this library enables stateful agents through peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It can be deployed as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with support for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory like a git repository, offering version control features such as commits, branches, and merges over a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms performance and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: This system provides a sub-millisecond AI memory architecture built on a standalone SQLite database with no external dependencies. It utilizes temporal knowledge graphs and episodic compression to manage agent context across various integrations and the Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system organizes memory into a Ground Truth hierarchy that includes persistent Qdrant vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It relies on local infrastructure like Docker, Redis, and SQLite to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving context harness uses filesystem-first traces and reports to help agents navigate complex tasks. It includes CLI tools for simulating and investigating tasks, supporting both Pi and MCP clients for context management.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost within the agent's history. It stores data in SQLite with FTS metadata and builds depth-aware summary nodes to facilitate efficient searching and expansion of context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for persistent state management.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams for multi-agent systems. It enables local-first, zero-cost search and supports MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and secrets layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. Users can inspect, edit, and repair memory through a dedicated dashboard and retrieval inspection tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and vector search without cloud dependencies. It captures agent decisions using a local GGUF observer model and integrates via MCP or Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that utilizes SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. The five-package plugin family includes a specific Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore for local-first persistence.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled item. It tracks contradictions via conflict and resolution primitives and supports both embedded in-process mode and HTTP backends.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context into a cache. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and creates bidirectional relationships between notes using edge tags.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the context they actually need. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports encrypted persistent memory through the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This project provides long-term, cross-project memory for AI coding agents by storing data as inspectable Markdown files. It utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features an importance ranking system for prioritized recall and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and provides an audit trace of all memory operations via trace.jsonl.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable, cross-session AI memory through semantic search. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and outbox to support cross-agent continuity via user-approved memories.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across various chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes and other platforms like elizaOS and n8n.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin offers private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It runs locally over localhost and supports grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It also includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and metadata/range filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills for coding agents and supports multiple agent harnesses via plugins. It includes specific workflows for debugging, code review, and TDD to serve as a software development methodology.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first design and prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It features automation and plugin capabilities, including CLI support for coding agents like Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to six major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These structured skills are compatible with Hermes Agent and over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language descriptions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw through Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated quality improvement and deduplication to unify skill libraries across devices and agents.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code, supporting installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals and dispute resolution. It utilizes natural-language mandates, x402 payments, and ERC-7710 delegated permissions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 822 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes integrations for Obsidian, Slack, n8n, Raycast, and MCP.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, using slash commands to manage and save patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This library provides skills for video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI through modular packages. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries and programmatic skills.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It incorporates a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project complexity.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running AI agents, this harness provides a three-level work model and supports file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository provides skills for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These skills provide standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families, including support for JSON structured prompting and hex color specification. They offer API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through the use of file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification via a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON payment commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It features built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This skill implements a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides a workflow language for AI via a single Rust binary. It features hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts and static auditing through a nika check command.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration validation.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill provides a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and uses langid or Unicode-range heuristics to preserve non-English prompts.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It utilizes a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec and provides a feedback MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and includes a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification for browsing, searching, and installing community skills. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face and operates autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with Hermes Agent and agentskills.io standards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news reports across multiple geographic scales, from global to street level. It includes quality gates, AI analysis, and integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. The packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no administrator rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes tools for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama as well as providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Kubernetes deployment with cloud-native state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and configurable gateway modes.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables Hermes AI assistant functionality on both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH). It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module provides declarative configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps through a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities while providing task scheduling and hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers and local Ollama models to power fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It employs structured-output agents to facilitate financial trading decision making.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other agents via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, memory browsing, scheduling, and spend monitoring.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation and handoffs. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and review queues. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and features a real-time dashboard for visualizing tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This system routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents architecture through parallel model querying and synthesis. It utilizes Hermes for tool-calling and task routing to run a fully-local stack on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and features automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage across multiple AI clients and coding agents, including Hermes. It features a native Rust TUI and a visualization dashboard for cross-platform monitoring of local agent session data.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool serves as a local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It allows users to export local trace sessions to HTML and redacts common auth headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, cost, and rate limits, reading Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLIs. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides detailed breakdowns of input, output, and cache-hit metrics.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents through encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible browser UI for real-time AI supervision and includes integrated session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework allows for the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder scoping. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local tools, memories, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It provides three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It operates without model or API calls by utilizing static regex and structural heuristics across multiple file formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides automated health monitoring and self-healing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for API requests, tool calls, and token intelligence tracking.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with the Tauri 2 framework that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides centralized management for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that supports multiple agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. It features built-in assistants for PPT, Word, and Excel, and enables remote access via WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed for use via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a three-panel layout with chat and workspace file browsing to provide full parity with the Hermes CLI experience.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to assist with the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that provides multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels such as Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It is available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker deployment and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects directly to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides dedicated views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A desktop application for Windows and macOS built using Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects the active browser context to a Hermes Agent runtime. It supports local, cloud, or remote gateways and includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace featuring one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and session overview. It features tool call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports Hermes, Codex, Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI. This local-only tool provides live per-session quota burn-rate tracking without telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace for managing Hermes Agent on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: A terminal dashboard built with OpenTUI that consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration. It integrates kanban boards for managing diagnostics and agentic tasks, alongside an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It provides terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachment support, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It features a GUI, a workflow engine for multi-step automation, and 100 tools including extensions for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent that provides real-time log streaming and chat. The interface includes a task tracking dashboard, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable mission-control dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A dashboard for process monitoring and configuration that tracks session activity and costs in real time. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories, skill source code, and read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace provides a chat-first interface featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for managing separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a streaming chat interface. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and supports model switching.
